props.label: Sequence
props.description:
The load sequence - meaning, if the load must be handled in FIFO basis, the shipments for the load must be organized that way as well. using this sequence field.

This field is required and defaults to 1000, lower numbers are presumed to be loaded ahead of larger numbers.

This correlates to the a stop sequence, but in reverse order.
